description_sq:
Ofrohet per shitje apartament 3+1 me organizim funksional dhe ndricim natyral ne cdo ambient.
Siperfaqe e bollshme, e ndare ne sallon ndenje me ambient gatimi, tre dhoma gjumi dhe dy tualete.
Rezidenca Colonnade njihet per ndertimin cilesor, pozicionin strategjik dhe qetesine qe ofron, vetem pak minuta nga qendra e Tiranes.
Zgjedhje ideale per familje qe kerkojne komoditet dhe cilesi jetese.
description_en: Offered for sale is a 3+1 apartment with functional organization and natural lighting in every environment. Spacious area, divided into living room with kitchen area, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. The Colonnade residence is known for its quality construction, strategic position and the tranquility it offers, just a few minutes from the center of Tirana. Ideal choice for families looking for comfort and quality of life.
